supersession_reason: Spec v3 stated the recommendation subset as 28 records and carried v1's endpoint families unchanged, flagging the RAGAS-primary / citation_precision endpoints as wrong pending the preregistration gate. v4 expands the subset to 33 records (EADO actinic-keratosis guideline ingested, AKIEC gap closed) and completes the endpoint re-registration (RAGAS demoted to supporting; provenance = citation_integrity; actionable specificity 0.90; alpha 0.05; 2000-replicate bootstrap; Holm within frozen families; power justification). PREREGISTRATION.json is updated in lockstep. v3 and its receipt are preserved byte-identical.
hash_convention: SHA-256 of raw file bytes exactly as stored
source_tree_revision_note: The exact revision for any run is recorded by that run. The recommendation corpus and guideline scope are guarded by their own receipts (recommendation_corpus.receipt.json, guideline_scope_v1/receipt.json) plus builder self-hash; spec v4 records their current hashes in its artifact_freeze_ledger.
two_tier_rationale: design_binding_files must not change without a version bump; observed_files are recorded for provenance and expected to drift.
design_binding_rule: These carry the freeze. If any one changes, this receipt becomes historical: issue v5 and state the reason. Never edit a version in place after viewing current-paper results.
observed_rule: Recorded for provenance at receipt creation. Drift is expected. The implementation cards become design-binding at the pre-H2H lock and must be re-pinned into design_binding_files at that point.

historical_versions.note: Pinned by five frozen artifacts (evidence bundle receipt, DermLIP perception receipt, three development-manifest files). Must never be edited.

Superseded by this v4 for the AK corpus expansion and the endpoint re-registration. Its design_binding pins (v3 spec + the pre-v4 PREREGISTRATION.json) are the historical record of the v3 design; the current prereg is pinned by this v4 receipt.

authorization: This receipt freezes the design only. It does not authorize paid generation or sealed-test access.
